new_scholarship.description: A bilateral scholarship scheme in which the Kingdom of Morocco awards places to Rwandan nationals to study at Moroccan public training institutions and universities, taught in French. The 2026/2027 call covers diploma, bachelor's, master's and PhD levels. Applications are handled by Rwanda's Higher Education Council through its HEC MIS online system rather than directly by the candidate. The published 2026/2027 application deadline was 29 August 2026, so this cycle has closed and the next call is expected in the same late-August window.

new_scholarship.description: A fully funded Egyptian government scholarship for students who have just finished secondary school, awarded by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research with the Central Bank of Egypt. programme_detail_official.description: Egypt's Future Scientists Scholarship is a fully funded government scholarship awarded by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research with the Central Bank of Egypt to high-achieving secondary school leavers. It pays the full cost of study together with accommodation and living costs at participating Egyptian national universities until graduation, in nine state-priority specialisms. Applicants are shortlisted electronically on their secondary school total mark with a geographic allocation across governorates, then must pass an admission test.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Full coverage of study costs, accommodation and living costs at participating Egyptian national universities until graduation

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are an Egyptian national with a secondary school certificate from a government school for 2025/2026

Check which of the nine specialisms are offered in your governorate, because allocation follows your school governorate or the nearest one

Holding a secondary certificate from a private school rather than a government school
Failing the admission test given after preliminary shortlisting
Already holding another scholarship funded by another party, which disqualifies the applicant
Being dismissed academically or disciplinarily from any institution, or having a conduct issue
estimated_uncovered_costs: Travel costs to and from the university, if the student is not from the same governorate
Books, stationery and personal expenses not covered by the full study-cost package
